messages:
sara: Heads-up — noticed repeated pulls of old base image sha:abc123 from staging after the CVE hotpatch. A few pods still using it. Thinking emergency slim/rootfs rebuild + RBAC tighten? :rotating_light:
omar: ack. do we have a vuln hit list? which CVE triggered this?
tyler: CVE-2026-1234 surfaced in the image scan yesterday, we flagged affected layers. CI image tags were rebuilt but some k8s deployments still reference the pinned sha.
jenn: can we block-pull the old sha at the registry while we coordinate? that would be fastest mitigation for staging.
sec-bot: registry-policy: create-blocklist request queued (id: blk-20260323-9). reviewer required: iam-admins.
maria: blocking at registry requires IAM change; need an owner to approve. also: audit logs for those pulls are in splunk index=images sourcetype=registry, pulling relevant events now.
oncall-joe: i'm oncall, I'll approve the blocklist if we do a coordinated window. Quick Q: will blocking break rollback paths for any canaries?
sara: good point — we should preserve a short rollback policy: keep a signed artifact in the offline bucket and prevent new pulls from the registry but allow internal rollbacks via signed image. also plan to rotate cosign keys after rebuild.
omar: cosign with cloud KMS? we currently use a software key on the signing host. switching to KMS/HSM would avoid key compromise during this rapid rebuild. any blockers?
tyler: ops infra supports GCP KMS and AWS KMS via keywrap, but cosign + KMS needs a small shim we already explored in last quarter. main blocker: RBAC role to allow the build service to sign with the key.
jenn: propose immediate mitigation steps: 1) registry block old sha, 2) patch k8s manifests to point at rebuilt image with canary tag, 3) spin a 5% canary for 30m, 4) monitor latency/error + audit logs.
maria: I'll extract the pull events and create a minimal playbook for postmortem. also logging: we need to ensure image-pull audit events include the cosign verification outcome — currently we only log digest and user.
sec-bot: alert: vuln-triage channel created -> #vuln-triage-1758675309
oncall-joe: i'll approve the registry block as long as we have a rollback owner and a signed artifact in the offline bucket. assigning rollback-owner @tyler.
tyler: assigned. i'll also add a deploy key and request a short-lived grant to sign with KMS if ops can approve. please add the KMS IAM role to the oncall grant.
sara: ops: can you quickly create a KMS signing role with 'kms.crypto.sign' for build-service@redwood? annotate with ttl 1h for the emergency.
maria: note for post-incident: add audit field image_signature_verified=true/false to our pull logs and forward to SIEM. that will help automated detection of unsigned rollbacks.
jenn: also: set a temporary admission-controller policy to require cosign signatures for images in staging and block anything unsigned for >24h.
tyler: admission controller can be pushed via a simple gate in the mutating webhook config; I'll open PR and tag @eng-runtime for quick review.
omar: small caveat: some legacy cronjobs in staging may still reference old images. we should list exemptions and remediate them separately.
sara: agreed. i'll compile exemptions and schedule a 30m triage call in 15. agenda: approvals, registry block, canary, KMS sign flow, admission webhook, rollback plan.
sec-bot: incident ticket CREATED: INC-2026-0454 (image hardening + key rotation)
oncall-joe: logging the go/no-go: i approve registry block now. doing it in 2m. notify channel once complete.
maria: pulling audit hits now — sending a short CSV to the incident ticket with pod names + image shas.
jenn: thanks. after canary verifies, we'll run mass reapply of manifests with new tags and schedule a full rebuild across all clusters this weekend with FIPS-aware signing.
tyler: FYI for KMS integration: need to confirm cosign version and add support for ephemeral grants. i'll open a follow-up RFC for permanent KMS plan.
sara: thanks team. keep updates here. if any failed canary, we cut the block and rollback. otherwise proceed with rotation and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
